title: Minicompat
description: Allows for Minimessage formatting in Chat, Anvils, Signs
body:
# Minicompat
A Simple yet useful Plugin that allows the use of Minimessage in Chat, Anvils, Signs.

With this Plugin you will be able to rename your Tools/Weapons in an Anvil using Minimessage Formatting, so you can get cool gradients or text effects on your Tools/Weapons. The Plugin also allows for Minimessage Support on Signs and in Chat, so you can type colorful chat messages or have multiple colors on a sign.


<details>
<summary>Chat Formatting Plugins Support</summary>
The Plugin will work fine with most Chat formatting Plugins since it only modifies the content of your message and not the rest of the Chat.

</details>
<details>
<summary>config.yml</summary>


```
anvil-enabled: true
chat-enabled: true
signs-enabled: true
```


</details>
